definitions.explanation: A formal word for someone's kindness, and especially for money or a gift given out of goodwill. Used almost always as ご{厚志|こうし}, in letters, speeches and notices.

examples.japanese: ご{厚志|こうし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{感謝|かんしゃ}→感謝：00181_kansha⟧⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: We are grateful for your kind gift.

examples.japanese: ⟦{皆様|みなさま}→皆様：15860_minasama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ご{厚志|こうし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{遊具|ゆうぐ}→遊具：17538_yuugu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{購入|こうにゅう}→購入：03057_kounyuu⟧⟦できました→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Thanks to your generous contributions, we were able to buy new playground equipment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{故人|こじん}→故人：02807_kojin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{遺志|いし}→遺志：31143_ishi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧、ご{厚志|こうし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{固|かた}く→固い：12090_katai⟧ご⟦{辞退|じたい}→辞退：03338_jitai⟧⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧。
examples.english: In keeping with the wishes of the deceased, we must respectfully decline all gifts.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal word for thank-you letters, donation reports and funeral notices. The last example is the standard wording when a family declines condolence money (⟦{香典|こうでん}→香典：06127_kouden⟧) and flowers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ご{厚志|こうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{賜|たまわ}る→賜る：07659_tamawaru⟧: to receive someone's kind gift (humble)
- ご{厚志|こうし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{感謝|かんしゃ}する→感謝する：06055_kanshasuru⟧: to thank someone for their generosity
- ご{厚志|こうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ご⟦{辞退|じたい}→辞退：03338_jitai⟧⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げる→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧: to decline gifts (in funeral notices)
